islamic_mode_hint:
Quran verse & Athan recognition and Islamic translation style.
Off = general translator for any content.
islamic_mode_off_confirm: Turn off Islamic mode? Quran verse recognition, Athan detection and the Islamic translation style will be disabled — the app becomes a general translator.
height_offset_hint: Transparent mode uses the whole screen, so this moves the subtitles and the footer up together.
dlg_enter_key: Enter a new OpenAI API key
dlg_key_session_only_warning: No keyring — the key applies to this session only.
dlg_stop_before_remove: Stop the app before removing the key.
dlg_stop_before_change_key: Stop the app before changing the key.
strategy_hint_realtime: Words appear as they're spoken — lowest delay. Needs a real-time engine key.
strategy_hint_semantic: Waits for whole sentences before translating — cleaner breaks, tuned for Arabic.
strategy_hint_chunk: Translates the audio in fixed segments — simple and reliable, no extra key.
subtitle_hint_realtime: Live feed from the top; each line settles once it's translated. Streaming only.
subtitle_hint_continuous: One line scrolls upward like a news ticker.
subtitle_hint_static: Shows only the most recent line, centered.
auto_stop_inactivity: Stop automatically after 10 min without speech
already_running_body:
MinbarLive is already running or is currently starting up!

Unless you meant to do this, please shut down the existing instance before starting a new one.
wizard_ui_language_sub: Language of the control panel (subtitles use their own setting).
wizard_audio_sub: Choose the audio input used for the live translation.
wizard_no_devices: No input devices found — you can choose one later in the control panel.
wizard_keys_info: Add keys for as many providers as you like by switching the list above. With OpenAI (the default), one key covers translation, real-time transcription and Quran verse detection.
wizard_gemini_rag_note: Quran verse detection uses OpenAI embeddings. Without an OpenAI key, verse matching is disabled.
wizard_gemini_latency_note: In real-time mode, Google's models transcribe slower than people speak, so subtitles fall further behind during long talks and only catch up when the speaker pauses. OpenAI keeps up better here. Chunk and semantic mode are not affected.
wizard_anthropic_stt_note: Claude has no speech-to-text — transcription runs on OpenAI, so an OpenAI key is also required.
wizard_deepgram_note: Deepgram only does real-time transcription — it has no translation and no embeddings for Quran verse detection. You also need a key for a translation provider (OpenAI, Google Gemini or Anthropic).
wizard_key_saved_hint: A key is already saved — leave empty to keep it.
wizard_key_help: Where do I get an API key?
batch_file_sub: Create translated subtitles (.srt) from a recording
batch_close_question: Cancel this run, or leave it working in the background? A background run still saves its file and appears in the history.
batch_ffmpeg_missing: ffmpeg not found — install ffmpeg to process this file format.
batch_ffmpeg_missing_hint: ffmpeg not found — install it and try again:  {command}
batch_ffmpeg_download_prompt: ffmpeg is required to convert this file format. Download it now? (one time, ~{mb} MB)
announce_sub: Show a message big on the subtitle screen
announce_favorites_full:
You can pin up to {max} favorites.
Remove a favorite before adding another.
history_delete_confirm:
Delete this history file?
This cannot be undone.
wizard_disclaimer_text: MinbarLive uses artificial intelligence to transcribe and translate speech in real time. AI translations can be wrong, incomplete or inaccurate — especially for religious content. The audio is sent to the selected AI provider for processing. Do not rely on the subtitles as an authoritative religious source.
wizard_disclaimer_accept: I understand that AI translations can be inaccurate.
include_prereleases: Also offer beta and test versions
integrated_windows_hint: Open settings, history and batch inside the main window (Esc closes) instead of as separate windows.
window_style_windows_only: In-app windows are only available on Windows for now — other systems always use separate windows.
adaptive_catchup: Speed up when subtitles fall behind
opacity_transparent_hint: Transparent mode has no background of its own, so this sets how dark the box behind each line is.
reset_hint: Removes every trace of MinbarLive from this computer: settings, session history, batch transcripts, logs and the API keys in your system keychain. Only do this if you no longer want to use MinbarLive. Moving to a newer version? It is enough to replace the program file — your settings are kept.
reset_confirm_text:
Are you sure you want to remove everything — all history, batch transcripts, logs, settings and your API keys?

This cannot be undone.

We only recommend this if you no longer want to use MinbarLive at all and want to leave nothing behind. If you are moving to a newer version of MinbarLive, we recommend keeping everything as it is and deleting only the program file (.exe / .app / .AppImage) — then all your settings are kept and you can carry straight on.
